paragraphs.text:
Despite efforts to help, the sufferer’s infection spreads from his 
foot wounds; his legs turn gangrenous. Soon his wasted body 
gives up the ghost and you lay him in a forest grave.
To go home, go to 76. To continue your exploration, go to 75.
